definition: נִסְרֹךְ proper name, of a divinity Assyrian god, worshipped by Sennacherib , 2Kgs 19:37 = Isa 37:38 ᵐ5 Εσδραχ , A Εσθραχ , ᵐ5 L Ασραχ ( Κ ); ᵐ5 Νασαραχ , א Ασαρακ , A Ασαραχ (Isaiah); Jos Ant. «JOSEPHUS:Antiquities 10:1»x. 1 , 5 Αρασκη ; no such god in cuneiform inscriptions; see views in Meinh Jesaiaerzählungen (1898) on the passage ; corrupt form of Nusku (= נסוך ) according to Hal Jas. xiii (1879), 387 = Mél. de. Crit. 177 Muss-Arn JBL xi.1 (1892), 86 ; Hebraica. vii. 89 R. 17; Nusku is a solar diety, compare Jastr Rel. Bab. 220 f . נֵעָה , נֹעָה see נוע .
